subject: Solstice dedicated capacity: fleet slice & priority mediation
messages:
From: Sara Park <sara@solsticelabs.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity request — Solstice Q3 launch

Hi Laura / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. To meet our Q3 2028 model-serving SLAs we need a firm answer on dedicated capacity sizing and whether Redwood can guarantee a non-preemptible tranche for our launch window (Aug 15 - Sep 30).

Quick summary of our ask: 
- Baseline reserved: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs (24/7)
- Peak burst: additional 12 GPUs for scheduled windows (4 hrs/day) during launch ramp
- KV caching and low-latency routing required (p95 < 200ms)

I've attached our MAU/throughput estimate and an initial schedule. We prefer dedicated pool but are open to split solutions (partial reserved + burst credits) if you can document preemption and fallback behavior.

We have procurement deadlines the week of Jun 25 and need any constraints or escalation steps if capacity contention arises. Please advise how you propose to slice the fleet and where we fit in the current tranche queue.

Attachments: [Attachment: solstice_mau_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72KB)]

Sara Park
Head of ML Infrastructure
Solstice Labs
+1 415-555-0132
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Park <sara@solsticelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — Solstice Q3 launch

Sara — thanks for the clear breakdown. We can support you but there are a few capacity contention constraints I need to call out up front (we're in a heavy tranche season for Q3). To keep this practical, I propose a mediation plan below and would like internal alignment before we return a formal offer.

Proposed mediation (high level):
1) Immediate: provision a soft-hold (non-billable) reservation window for 8 GPUs through Jul 31 to allow procurement to complete sign-off. This hold blocks allocation but is revocable with 7 days notice.
2) Launch tranche (Aug 15 - Sep 30): provide 8x reserved, plus 8x burstable GPUs guaranteed with <10% preemption risk. Remaining 4 burst GPUs can be provided as best-effort (preemptible).
3) Fallbacks: automatic fallback to a compatible quantized model variant + regional routing (eu-us) if preemption occurs; documented SLO degradation paths.
4) Priority ruleset: define a 'launch-critical' tag for customers with signed reserved contracts + launch window — these get higher placement in allocation queue; disputes escalate to the capacity committee (me, Ben, Marcus, Karthik).

I attach a draft tranche schedule and will flag the HubSpot deal for accelerated review. Two asks for you: 1) confirm the MAU numbers in the attached spreadsheet and 2) confirm whether Solstice can accept 4 of the 12 burst GPUs as preemptible.

Attachments: [Attachment: proposed_tranche_schedule.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Park <sara@solsticelabs.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — Solstice Q3 launch

Looping in here — happy to lead the commercial side. Quick commercial notes:
- We can do the soft-hold through Jul 31 as Laura suggested.
- For the launch tranche I recommend a split: 8x reserved + 8x guaranteed burst + 4x preemptible. That reduces cost and gives you predictable throughput for key windows.
- If Solstice needs full non-preemptible for all 12 burst GPUs we can offer that under a short-term premium (one-off fee) or a multi-month committed discount.

I placed a note on the HS deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/DL-2028-089 — please add any procurement contacts so I can push finance for expedited capacity assignment.

Ben / Marcus — if we expect contention in late Aug, can we pre-authorize a capacity committee exception to move Solstice ahead of existing mid-tier commitments if contract signee date is before Jul 10? I want a decision rule we can relay to procurement.

Karthik
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: procurement@solsticelabs.com
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-finance@cloudpartner.io
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — Solstice Q3 launch

Laura / Karthik,

Thanks for the proposal. We can accept 4 preemptible burst GPUs but not at the expense of launch reliability — Solstice must avoid interruptions during user-facing rollouts. We need confirmed placement in the tranche queue and an escalation path if preemption probability exceeds 5% during a scheduled window.

Contract timeline: procurement is prepared to sign by Jul 2 if Redwood can: 
- Convert the soft-hold to a guaranteed reservation by Jul 10 (if not, we need an explicit rollback clause), and
- Provide a written SLA for the guaranteed burst GPUs (8) with monetary credits for missed availability.

CloudPartner (cc) is our preferred cloud brokerage for any required augmentation; please confirm whether Redwood coordinates with your marketplace partners for temp capacity surges.

Best,
Procurement Team
Solstice Labs
